pull_request.title: Add native per-account SQLite storage foundation
pull_request.body:
Native Desktop/Mobile clients previously had only placeholder directories. This adds a per-account SQLite storage foundation and two thin native Dart consumers. Local send, committed ACK, realtime and Sync writes converge transactionally on the same row, preserve terminal SENT, and update data plus cursors atomically. Private schema1 includes genuine initial migration, failure and future-version checks.

The existing Desktop/Mobile CI jobs and their compatibility steps now execute native storage tests instead of S0 placeholder rejection. Existing backend/contracts/security/ACK semantics remain unchanged. Prior recovery/brand records are preserved byte-for-byte. This is the first S2 storage task; full client UI, network send/Sync orchestration, device acceptance and S2 Gate completion remain outside this change.

Validation: native shared24 + Desktop1 + Mobile1 tests, strict Dart analyze/format/locked dependencies, frozen/architecture34, source boundaries, CI29, WSS18 and Sync79 vectors pass locally. Four Windows symlink privilege subcases require Linux CI. Fresh independent review and exact-head hosted required jobs are pending; local evidence is not task acceptance. Implementation Recorder finished FAIL for a disclosed startup association error and passed structural validation; historical failures remain preserved.
